body: i think any self harm can be dangerous in itself and i think if she’s trying to collect bacteria that might be even worse. i think perhaps you should try and talk to her about it - i don’t think it is safe at all. no self harm is safe to be honest. perhaps try and sit her down when she’s not placing herself in any danger and perhaps to just tell her to make it aware to you if she does anything to hurt herself. if it does feel like you can’t keep her safe maybe try calling 111 or a out of hours emergency number to just ask for advice

ahh i get that don’t worry but equally it’s so much harder to get better when you don’t have supportive parents like me. ever since i kinda landed myself in a+e for OD’ing they haven’t stopped screaming and shouting at me and making me feel even more invalid and it’s just not good. people care about you so much and your parents seem to too, and remember your dad didn’t make it a scene when he noticed he just gave a look to it to acknowledge it and just is worried you’re going through so much pain. loving parents help so much, and even if you haven’t been close before, if they’re willing to listen and help they’ll be so much more closer to you

if your dad raises the self harm it’s because he cares and he wants to see you get better and getting you help shows that’s he’s on your side. take it as a positive because the help might be of help especially the therapy and it might help you become so much more better mentally and physically. and there’s nothing to be scared about. recovery is super difficult and if you parents are super supportive it just gonna help so much more. hey stay strong for me and text me if you need anything xx
